# Optional OEM media-key source

This directory is GPL-3.0-only work. It adds an independently authored, disabled-by-default media-key Binder producer to the pinned `JSN.KOR.SOP.V141.250902.STD_H` automotive-service JAR. The producer handles only physical `0xde`/`0xdf` Next/Previous events. It does not implement or advertise a play/pause hardware mapping.

The builder requires the exact c8 audio composite JAR (`a28006e0...`) and its smali source to reproduce the original `classes.dex` before patching. It changes only `ModeKeyDispatcher.smali` and adds new helper classes; the earlier history, PTT, and audio components stay in the JAR. The candidate is unsigned and uninstalled. `persist.vn.media_keys=1` is required before dispatcher construction, and the builder does not change this property.

The Hub client hashes `/system/framework/automotive-service.jar` against the selected candidate and probes a read-only Binder transaction on a worker before Consumer HID declaration. The probe checks the boot ID, protocol, and service-reported system UID; the producer checks the exact Hub package UID and signing certificate on every Binder call. A missing or mismatched service leaves the Consumer HID undeclared. A declared source that later fails retires its verified session through `ReceiverHardwareConsumerSource`.

The Hub's current verified session, observed `ModeControl` audio owner PHONE, no call/Siri, and explicit CarPlay media choice gate DOWN. Current RTP activity is not required so a paused media stream can receive Next/Previous. A claimed DOWN means a report was queued to the session's Consumer worker, not acknowledged by the phone. An unknown callback outcome consumes and quarantines the physical pair; it does not fall back to the original mode listener. An unclaimed DOWN follows the original OEM path. An owned UP is consumed before mode and view gates so a changed mode cannot strand a press.

The original 250902 `ModeKeyDispatcher` code path is bytecode-reassembled and statically replayed in the receipts. The downloaded 260114 DiPO APK/native files are not treated as 250902 originals. This framework hook requires no DiPO patch and no match to DiPO's HID descriptor. The independently declared Consumer HID and encrypted phone delivery still lack vehicle/iPhone validation. No signed APK/JAR, installation, deployment, push, or vehicle action is part of this work.
